intro: Encroachment is a Horde quest directed by Gar'Thok at Razor Hill in central Durotar. It charges champions with striking deep into the western bramble dens to eliminate the entrenched Razormane quilboar threatening the borders of the young orc nation.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: When we arrived, the Razormane quilboars possessed much of the land, and proved a thorn in our sides. Through our efforts we have driven out the largest part of their numbers, but still they remain well-fortified in some areas.

It has gone on long enough, however. For our own protection, we cannot allow the Razormane any hold in our lands. Their camps can be found to the west of here. Look for the brambles and you will find them. Today we drive them from Durotar, tomorrow, perhaps from all of Kalimdor.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I will pass along word that the quilboars have been removed from their lairs, and that their structures may be set to fire. The removal of the Razormane from Durotar brings us closer to fully securing the borders of our new homeland.
